reason: Each normative SPEC.md FR-03 bullet maps to an assertion that fails if the requirement is violated. (1) /v1/* needs a key and a missing or invalid key gives 401 problem+json: test_fr03.py:138-141 (missing key), :152-155 plus :157 (invalid key, with a valid key still accepted so deny-all fails), and :174-175 (every registered /v1 route returns 401). (2) SHA-256 hash only, no plaintext: :198-202 compare the stored key_hash with sha256 of the printed key, and :204 fails if the plaintext is in the DB dump or file bytes. compare_digest is required by :219-220, where a spy fails if it is never called or is not given the hash. (3) Plaintext printed once by the real `python -m taskq_api key create --scope`: :230 (exit code), :236 (exactly one occurrence across stdout and stderr), :239 (the issued key authenticates). An unknown scope is rejected with no row at :247-249. (4) A key with revoked_at set is invalid: :269-270 use the seeded revoked key, which hashes correctly, so only the revoked_at check can produce the 401. :300-302 repeat this for POST. (5) /healthz and /readyz need no key: :282-283 and :285-286.
